result.instructions: Tools for Prodigi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my ten most recent print orders and tell me whether more pages remain."; "Show the production status and shipment tracking for a Prodigi order ID I provide."; "Look up the available attributes and print areas for a product SKU I provide.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Prodigi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run prodigi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run prodigi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run prodigi_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. prodigi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: prodigi_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List print orders of this Prodigi account, newest first (sorted by order id, descending), with status stage, items, shipments and charges. Filter by status, creation time, Prodigi order ids or your own merchant references. Paging: top (1-100, default 10) and skip; the reply has has_more and next_skip. Recipient names and addresses are real customer data. GET /orders.

skip.description: Orders to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

created_from.description: Only orders placed after this time (UTC).

created_to.description: Only orders placed before this time (UTC).

merchant_references.description: Only orders with these merchant references.

tools.name: prodigi_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One print order by Prodigi order id: status stage and per-step details (asset download, production, shipping), issues, charges, shipments with tracking, recipient, items with print assets and costs, metadata. The webhook callbackUrl is reduced to its host. GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: prodigi_get_order_actions
tools.title: Get order actions
tools.description: Which changes Prodigi still allows on an order right now (cancel, change recipient details, change shipping method, change metadata), each with isAvailable (Yes/No). Only reports availability; it changes nothing. GET /orders/{id}/actions.

tools.name: prodigi_create_quote
tools.title: Get a price quote
tools.description: Price a print order WITHOUT creating or charging one: item cost, shipping (per shipping method, or all methods when none is given), branding inserts, tax and total, with carrier, fulfilment lab and unit costs, in the account's currency unless currency_code is set. Each item needs a sku, copies and the print areas (assets, e.g. printArea 'default'); books take pageCount. Items with problems come back as outcome CreatedWithIssues. POST /quotes (read-only: nothing is saved or billed).

destination_country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country the order would ship to, e.g. GB.

shipping_method.description: Only quote this method; omit to get all methods.

currency_code.description: 3-letter ISO currency, e.g. USD (default: the account's setting).

inserts.description: Branding inserts to include (each at most once).

tools.name: prodigi_get_product
tools.title: Get product details
tools.description: Details of one Prodigi product by SKU: description, dimensions, the attribute names and allowed values (size, wrap, colour...), print areas and which are required, and variants with the countries each ships to and the print-area pixel sizes. Use it to build valid quote requests. GET /products/{sku}.

tools.name: prodigi_get_spine_width
tools.title: Get book spine width
tools.description: Calculate the spine width in mm of a book product for a page count (for cover artwork). A pure calculation: nothing is created or charged. POST /products/spine.

destination_country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country the book would ship to, e.g. GB.

state.description: State/county of the destination, if the product needs it.

number_of_pages.description: Number of pages in the book.

prompts.title: Get started with Prodigi
